orchestrator.role: You are the executor for the Rain UI/UX level-up program. Execute the tasks below in order. Do not redesign the plan. Do not ask questions unless a task says STOP. Every task has exact steps, a verify block and a commit block: do them literally. Be terse in chat. Put details in files. When a step says "find" or "check", do it with Grep/Read first; never guess an API or a file shape.

facts.shell: PowerShell 5.1. No bash. Chain with ';'. Never use '&&'.
facts.app: apps/rain: Flutter app for Android and Windows. Riverpod 3, go_router 17, Material 3, audioplayers ^6.6.0, google_fonts ^8.1.0, flutter_svg. Presentation code lives in apps/rain/lib/presentation (about 19,300 lines).
facts.theme: apps/rain/lib/presentation/theme/rain_theme.dart (501 lines): RainColors, RainTextureTokens, RainMotion (quick 110, standard 150, slow 220, page 130, splashIntro 520, ambientLoop 4200 ms), RainTheme.dark()/light(), custom fade+slide page transition. Fonts: Inter (body) + Space Grotesk (titles/labels) via google_fonts, fetched at RUNTIME from Google's servers (no bundled font files, no allowRuntimeFetching=false anywhere). Dark theme has no snackBarTheme (only light theme defines one, rain_theme.dart:386). No spacing or radius tokens: 79 BorderRadius.circular literals and 89 Color(0x..) literals in presentation/.
facts.motion: Reduced motion is computed ad hoc: MediaQuery.disableAnimations || RainPerformanceScope.of(context).isLowPower (splash_screen.dart:119-120 and others). RainPerformanceProfile (presentation/performance/rain_performance.dart) marks armv7 Android as lowPower; allowContinuousCallAnimation / allowExpensiveCallEffects gate call effects. 0 AnimatedSwitcher, 0 Hero, 0 HapticFeedback, 2 AnimationController in presentation/.
facts.loading_states: Startup: main.dart RainStartupApp shows a bare MaterialApp(home: RainSplashScreen()) with no theme while bootstrap runs, then BootstrapFailureApp (ThemeData.dark(), not RainTheme) on error, then RainApp (presentation/screens/rain_app.dart) whose builder shows RainStartupSurface (screens/startup_surface.dart) for AppStartupPhase {checkingUpdate, validatingSession, startingRuntime, deletingAccount, updateRequired, sessionExpired, failed} (enum in application/state/app_startup_state.dart:12). Every loading phase renders the same RainSplashScreen ("Rain" / "Private peer link"): no phase caption, and because the splash is re-mounted in up to 3 different MaterialApps, the 520 ms scale intro and the orbital mark animation (branding/rain_peer_core_mark.dart) restart at each hand-off. No cross-fade into onboarding/home. RainStartupFailureScreen shows raw error.toString() and has no retry. Force-update gate is a plain Card. Account deletion is a bare CircularProgressIndicator. Android native splash: res/drawable(-v21)/launch_background.xml is a flat #061017 rectangle, no mark; no values-v31 splash-screen styles. test/android_splash_resources_test.dart pins the colour. Skeleton: RainStreakSkeleton (branding/rain_state_surfaces.dart:113) is static grey bars; used at chat_panel.dart ~908, friends_list.dart ~99, search_screen.dart ~305, settings_screen.dart ~1868. 15 ad-hoc CircularProgressIndicator + 1 LinearProgressIndicator (file_transfer_bubble.dart ~105, value jumps, no tween). Two empty/error state widgets: AppStateMessage (widgets/app_components.dart:183, 12 uses) and RainMistStateCard (branding/rain_state_surfaces.dart:7, 2 uses). Five copies of the same "make error readable" helper: home_screen.dart:48, friend_profile_screen.dart:388, onboarding_screen.dart:197, search_screen.dart:28, settings_screen.dart:26 (_formatSettingsError). Raw error.toString() still reaches the UI at search_screen.dart:242 and chat_panel.dart ~883-897.
facts.sound: assets/sounds: 15 deterministic WAVs (mono 44.1 kHz 16-bit) generated by apps/rain/tool/generate_rain_sound_assets.dart (404 lines); README in assets/sounds/README.md; asset contract test test/sound_effects_assets_test.dart (duration windows, loop RMS, one unique file per RainSoundEffect). Playback: infrastructure/services/sound_effects_service.dart (RainSoundEffect enum, asset map, RainSoundPlayer interface, AudioplayersRainSoundPlayer, lazily created players = first-play latency, no preload, loops stop abruptly). Policy: application/audio/sound_event_router.dart (throttle windows lines 13-33, effect mapping _effectFor at ~629). Events: application/audio/rain_sound_event.dart (RainSoundEventKind). Provider: application/state/sound_event_providers.dart. Dispatch sites: pure diff functions + dispatch in presentation/screens/home_screen.dart (~140-460) and onboarding_screen.dart (~669-695). Shared cues today: camera on/off, route change and "request accepted" all play action.wav; inbound connection request plays receive.wav (same as a chat message); rejected/expired play error.wav. File transfers have no sound at all. Settings: AppAudioSettings (infrastructure/services/app_settings_store.dart:37) with soundEffectsEnabled, soundEffectsVolume, callSoundsEnabled, connectionRequestSoundsEnabled, reduceSoundsDuringCall; the volume Slider is in settings_screen.dart _VoiceAudioSettingsControls (~1550-1630) and plays no preview.
facts.files_over_limit: CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml ~133) fails any lib/ file over 3200 lines and warns over 800. Presentation files already over 800: chat_panel.dart 1914, settings_screen.dart 1909, home_screen.dart 1788, rain_chat_widgets.dart 1554, rain_call_overlay.dart 1521, rain_call_controls.dart 1099. Put new widgets in NEW files; never grow these by more than ~40 lines per task.
facts.hardening_program: audit/prompts/rain-orchestrator.xml runs in D:\Rain on branch audit/rain-hardening (Phase 4 cards done, follow-ups SEC-002/CI-002 ongoing). Its backlog owns refactor target 5 (split chat_panel.dart and home_screen.dart into separate files; audit/02-refactor-targets.md §5) and all runtime, signaling, crypto, rules, CI and package work. integration/main-dev is its main-merge branch.
facts.project_rules: AGENTS.md is binding; .ai/impeccable.md is the UI rulebook (match the existing design system, no decorative UI that does not help comprehension, no cards in cards, text must fit on phone and desktop).

ownership.rule: chat_panel.dart and home_screen.dart: small in-place edits only. Do not move code out of them, do not split them, do not reorder their members. That refactor belongs to the hardening program.
If a task cannot be done without touching a must_not_edit path: do the part that fits, record the rest in audit/ui/STATE.md under "Handoff to hardening" with the exact change needed, and continue.

hard_rules.rule: Work only in D:\Rain-uiux on branch ui/level-up. Never edit, switch branches in, stage in, or run build/test commands in D:\Rain (the hardening checkout). The only commands allowed in D:\Rain are the "git worktree add" and "git fetch" in T0.1.
Never commit to main, dev, audit/rain-hardening or integration/main-dev. Never force-push. Never rewrite history. Never run git reset --hard, git clean, git stash, git rebase.
Respect the ownership block above for every edit.

No new runtime or dev dependencies. Use Flutter built-ins (AnimatedSwitcher, TweenAnimationBuilder, AnimationController, HapticFeedback, SystemSound) and packages already in pubspec.yaml. No shimmer, lottie, flutter_animate, rive or similar.

Every animation must have a reduced-motion path: when RainMotionPolicy (T1.3) says reduced, render the end state with Duration.zero and run no repeating ticker. Continuous call animations also require RainPerformanceProfile.allowContinuousCallAnimation.
Every new user-visible string is plain, short and calm; never show raw exception text, stack traces, Firebase codes or paths. Use rainUserFacingError (T1.4).
Interactive widgets added or touched get a stable ValueKey('qa.feature.action') and a Semantics label or tooltip (AGENTS.md QA rule).
Sound assets are only ever produced by tool/generate_rain_sound_assets.dart. Never download, copy or hand-edit audio. One-shot sounds stay under 1 s; loops start and end near zero amplitude.
Do not run platform builds (flutter build ...). Device checks go to the Owner actions list.

If a verify step fails: fix and re-run up to 3 times. Still failing: revert only your own changes for that task (git checkout -- the files you edited in this task; Remove-Item files you created in this task), record it in audit/ui/STATE.md under "Blocked" with the exact error, and continue with the next task.
STOP means: write the reason in audit/ui/STATE.md, commit, push, then end the session with a 3-line summary.
Never print, copy or commit secret values. Never commit files under apps/rain/build, .dart_tool or test/ui_snapshots/goldens.

tools.note: TEST_APP takes about 2 minutes, TEST_ALL about 3. Use TEST_ONE while iterating; run TEST_APP before every commit that touches lib/.
Read files with Grep (pattern + -n + small -C) or Read with offset/limit. Never read a file over 400 lines in full.
Use Context7 to confirm any Flutter, audioplayers or google_fonts API before using it.

commit_protocol.step: git add only the files this task changed (list them explicitly; never "git add -A" or ".").

Message format: "<type>(<scope>): <summary>" then a blank line, then "Task: <task id>". Types: feat, fix, refactor, test, docs, chore, perf, style. Scopes: ui, theme, splash, loading, sound, haptics, a11y, audit.
git commit -m "<subject>" -m "Task: <id>". Never use --no-verify. If a hook fails, fix the cause.
Push after every phase: git push -u origin ui/level-up. On network failure retry 4 times waiting 2, 4, 8, 16 seconds.
After committing, append one line to audit/ui/STATE.md "Done": "<task id> <short sha> <one-line result>" and include STATE.md in the NEXT commit (do not amend).

resume_protocol.step: At session start run ENV, then: git status --short --branch; Get-Content audit/ui/STATE.md.
If D:\Rain-uiux does not exist: start at T0.1. If it exists and the branch is not ui/level-up: STOP.
Continue from the first task not listed under "Done" or "Blocked" in audit/ui/STATE.md.
Do not re-run finished tasks. Do not re-read files already summarized in audit/ui/*.md.

sync_protocol.step: git log --oneline HEAD..origin/audit/rain-hardening. If empty: done.

Otherwise: git merge --no-ff origin/audit/rain-hardening -m "chore(merge): sync audit/rain-hardening into ui/level-up". Conflict policy: for any path outside may_edit take theirs (git checkout --theirs -- path); for presentation and audio files keep both behaviours by hand. Then ANALYZE_APP; TEST_APP. If more than 5 tests fail after 3 fix rounds: STOP and list them.
If origin/audit/rain-hardening has been deleted or merged into dev: fetch dev and apply the same steps with origin/dev.

U-D2 Direction: keep Rain's existing dark "signal mist" identity (cyan/mint on deep ink, Space Grotesk + Inter). Level up consistency, motion, feedback and sound; no rebrand, no new palette. task.name: Bundle Inter and Space Grotesk; stop runtime font fetching
task.why: Rain is a private P2P app: today every launch asks fonts.googleapis.com for fonts (privacy leak, and offline first launch shows a fallback font then swaps). Bundling fixes both.

steps.s: Use Context7 on google_fonts to confirm how bundled fonts are matched (asset folder, required file names per family and weight, and variable-font support in google_fonts 8.x).

Obtain the exact TTF files google_fonts expects for Inter weights 400/500/600/700 and Space Grotesk 500/600/700 from the official Google Fonts sources (github.com/google/fonts, OFL licensed), plus each family's OFL.txt. Put them under apps/rain/assets/google_fonts/ with the names the package requires.
apps/rain/pubspec.yaml: add "- assets/google_fonts/" to flutter: assets. Nothing else in pubspec changes.
rain_theme.dart: first line of RainTheme._textTheme sets GoogleFonts.config.allowRuntimeFetching = false.
New test test/rain_fonts_bundled_test.dart: for each expected file name, File('assets/google_fonts/...').existsSync() is true, and OFL.txt files exist.

task.fallback: If the exact static files cannot be obtained or google_fonts cannot match them: revert this task (U11), record "T1.1 Blocked: <reason>" and continue; runtime fetching stays as today. Do not substitute other fonts.

Extend test/chat_composer_test.dart for the stable width.

Find where the peer avatar/identity is drawn for VoiceCallPhase connectingPeer, outgoingRinging, connectingMedia and reconnecting (Grep in widgets/calls/rain_call_stage.dart and rain_call_controls.dart around the phase labels at ~867-917) and wrap that avatar in RainConnectingPulse; reconnecting uses RainColors.warning.

phase.name: Sound design and haptics
phase.task_rule: Run sync_protocol first. Same per-task rule. Never edit WAV files directly (U9).

task.name: Sound map (read-only)

steps.s: Table: RainSoundEventKind | effect | file | duration ms | peak | RMS | volume scale | throttle/suppression rule. Read durations from sound_effects_assets_test.dart; compute peak and RMS with a throwaway Dart script in the session scratchpad (NOT in the repo) that reads each WAV.
List the shared cues (from <sound> facts) and the missing ones (file transfer complete/failed) and say which task fixes each.

task.commit: docs(audit): sound map with loudness and throttle rules

task.name: New distinct cues in the generator

steps.s: tool/generate_rain_sound_assets.dart: add specs, all in the existing droplet vocabulary (_Droplet/_Shimmer), mono 44.1 kHz: camera_on.wav (≈130 ms, two rising droplets 880→1320 Hz), camera_off.wav (≈130 ms, falling 1320→880 Hz), route_change.wav (≈90 ms, single soft 1040 Hz tick), request_inbound.wav (≈420 ms, gentle two-note 660 then 990 Hz, distinct from receive.wav), request_accepted.wav (≈300 ms, three rising droplets 660/880/1100 Hz), transfer_complete.wav (≈260 ms, two bright droplets 990/1480 Hz with light shimmer). targetPeak for each ≤ the current send.wav peak (9000) except request_inbound (≤ 9600).

Do not change existing specs in this task. Run SOUNDGEN; git status must show only the six new WAVs as new and the 15 old WAVs unchanged (if old files changed byte-for-byte, the generator is not deterministic: STOP).
Update assets/sounds/README.md "Current sound direction" with one line per new file.

task.commit: feat(sound): generate distinct cues for camera, route, requests and transfers

task.name: Map the new cues and add transfer events

steps.s: sound_effects_service.dart: add RainSoundEffect cameraOn, cameraOff, routeChange, requestInbound, requestAccepted, transferComplete and their asset paths.
rain_sound_event.dart: add RainSoundEventKind fileTransferCompleted and fileTransferFailed with factories (transferId required, normalized like requestId; peerId optional).

sound_event_router.dart _effectFor: cameraMute→cameraOff, cameraUnmute→cameraOn, routeChanged→routeChange, connectionRequestInbound→requestInbound, outboundAccepted→requestAccepted, fileTransferCompleted→transferComplete, fileTransferFailed→error. Policy: transfer sounds dedupe per transferId for 10 minutes, at most one transfer sound per 1500 ms, suppressed by reduceSoundsDuringCall while a call is active and during ringing; gated by soundEffectsEnabled.

Tests: sound_effects_assets_test.dart gets duration windows for the six files (±15 ms around the measured value) and keeps the unique-file assertion; sound_event_router_test.dart gets mapping + dedupe + throttle + in-call suppression cases; rain_sound_event_test.dart gets factory validation.

task.commit: feat(sound): distinct cues for camera, route, requests and transfer events

task.name: Play transfer sounds for the open conversation

steps.s: New file presentation/widgets/home/file_transfer_sound_events.dart with a pure function List<RainSoundEvent> rainFileTransferSoundEventsFor({List<FileTransferRecord>? previous, required List<FileTransferRecord> next}) returning completed/failed events only for records whose state changed into completed/failed between previous and next (never on first load where previous is null). Follow the shape of rainChatReceiveSoundEventFor in home_screen.dart (~225-240).

chat_panel.dart: next to the existing ref.listen on messages (~144), add ref.listen on fileTransfersProvider(peerId) that dispatches those events through soundEventRouterProvider (same unawaited pattern as home_screen.dart:325). Max ~15 added lines in chat_panel.dart.
Scope note in STATE.md Decisions: transfer sounds play for the open conversation only; app-wide transfer sounds need a runtime event and are a hardening handoff.
Test test/file_transfer_sound_events_test.dart: first load → none; sending→completed → one completed; receiving→failed → one failed; unchanged list → none.

task.commit: feat(sound): play a cue when a transfer in the open chat completes or fails

task.name: Warm up sounds to remove first-play delay

steps.s: Context7: confirm audioplayers 6.x AudioPlayer.setSource(AssetSource) preloads without playing on Android and Windows.

RainSoundPlayer interface: add Future<void> preload(String assetPath). AudioplayersRainSoundPlayer implements it with setSource. Update every fake player in tests (Grep "implements RainSoundPlayer" in test/).

SoundEffectsService.warmUp(Set<RainSoundEffect> effects): creates the one-shot player for each effect (same id scheme as play), configures it, preloads; errors are caught and recorded in diagnostics like play failures; safe to call twice.
sound_event_providers.dart: after creating the router, schedule unawaited(effects.warmUp({send, receive, action, error})) once.
Tests in sound_effects_service_test.dart: warmUp preloads each asset once; a later play reuses the same player; warmUp failure does not throw.

task.commit: perf(sound): preload frequent cues to remove first-play latency

task.name: Fade loops out instead of cutting

steps.s: RainSoundPlayer: add Future<void> setVolume(double v) (audioplayers setVolume). SoundEffectsService stopLoop/stopAllLoops: ramp the loop's volume to 0 in 4 steps over 120 ms, then stop and dispose. stopAll (app exit) stays immediate.
Tests with fakeAsync in sound_effects_service_test.dart: volumes recorded in descending order then stop; stopAll is immediate.

task.commit: feat(sound): fade ringing loops out instead of cutting them

Add a small TextButton 'Play test sound' (key qa.settings.sound_test) next to the slider, disabled when sound effects are off.
Keep settings_screen.dart growth under 40 lines; put the button widget in a new file presentation/widgets/settings/sound_preview_button.dart if needed.
Extend test/settings_screen_test.dart: releasing the slider calls the preview callback once; the button is disabled when sound effects are off.

task.name: Loudness consistency check

steps.s: Using the T3.1 numbers, add to sound_effects_assets_test.dart a test that groups one-shots (chat: send/receive; ui: action/route_change/camera_on/camera_off/mute/unmute/deafen/undeafen; state: call_connected/call_ended/request_accepted/transfer_complete; alert: error/call_failed/request_inbound/call_incoming/call_outgoing) and asserts RMS within each group stays within 3 dB of the group median.
If a file fails: adjust only that spec's targetPeak in the generator, run SOUNDGEN, and confirm only that file changed. Record every adjusted file in STATE.md Notes.

task.name: Haptic feedback on Android

steps.s: app_settings_store.dart: add a bool setting hapticFeedbackEnabled (default true) with getter/setter following the pattern of an existing bool setting in that file, plus a provider in a NEW file application/state/feedback_settings_providers.dart.

steps.s: Sections: Results (task, sha, one line), Blocked (exact errors), Handoff to hardening, Owner actions (from STATE.md plus: run the app on Android and Windows and walk startup → onboarding → chat → call → settings; check reduced motion via Android "Remove animations" and Windows "Show animations" off; listen review of all cues; native splash cold-start check; merge decision), Before/after validation table, Remaining ideas (not done, one line each).
